description: This file defines prototypes for custom data model APIs related to device information in a CCSP software platform. It includes function declarations for getting and setting boolean and string parameters, and contains licensing and copyright information.

methods.name: DeviceInfo_GetParamBoolValue_Custom
methods.description: Retrieves a boolean parameter value for device info, given a context handle and parameter name.

methods.name: DeviceInfo_GetParamStringValue_Custom
methods.description: Retrieves a string parameter value for device info, given a context handle, parameter name, and size pointer.

methods.name: DeviceInfo_SetParamBoolValue_Custom
methods.description: Sets a boolean parameter value for device info, given a context handle and parameter name.
